2201.translation: Change y to i and add es.

2204.translation: For verbs wey end with vowel + y, just add -s.

2206.translation: play → plays (vowel + y just dey take -s).

2208.translation: do too dey change for third person singular.

2211.translation: place wey you dey read and borrow books

2212.translation: place wey you dey buy and eat food

2213.translation: place for outside wey get grass and trees for play

2214.translation: li-brar-y: think about place wey get plenty books.

2215.translation: Na place wey you dey borrow books.

2216.translation: Library na place wey you fit read and borrow books.

2217.translation: Which word mean 'place wey students dey go learn'?

2220.translation: school na place wey students dey go learn.

2221.translation: Write di word for this: table wey you dey sit down study or write.

2222.translation: Na four-letter word wey start with d.

2225.translation: I drink ____ in the morning. (white drink wey come from cows)

2226.translation: Think about di white drink wey come from cows.

2228.translation: I drink milk in the morning. (Na milk I dey drink for morning.)

2229.translation: She is very ____. She always helps her friends.

2230.translation: Which kind person always dey help friends?

2231.translation: Choose di word wey mean say person dey treat others well and dey care for dem.

2232.translation: E always dey help friends, so kind (kind and caring) fit.

2234.translation: person wey dey help sick people recover

2235.translation: person wey dey protect people and stop crime

2237.translation: This person dey teach us for school.

2239.translation: Teacher na person wey dey teach you for school.

2240.translation: Write di word for this: something wey you dey put your things inside to carry dem.

2241.translation: Na three-letter word wey start with b.

2244.translation: Di answer na Would you like me to carry that bag for you? Would you like me to + base verb na natural pattern for offering help. May I to carry no correct because to no fit directly follow May.

2245.translation: When you dey offer help, check di grammar pattern, like di verb form, and whether di expression polite.

2246.translation: For each option, compare whether di verb after would, will, may or want get di correct form, and di direction of di help: "I'll help you" or "help me".

2247.translation: Di answer na Sorry to interrupt, but may I add one point? Na polite expression wey apologize and ask permission. Di option wey start with Excuse me look polite, but e mean 'I no go add anything', so e no fit di purpose.

2248.translation: When you dey interrupt person, first check whether di tone polite before di content.

2249.translation: Compare whether each option respect di other person and whether di content fit di purpose of adding opinion.

2250.translation: Di answer na Thank you! I got it last week. Reply compliment with thanks and continue di conversation. Di others dey contradict di compliment or take am badly, so dem sound awkward.

2251.translation: Think how you go reply compliment for your own language, and check whether di reply preserve di other person good mood.

2252.translation: Separate di options into replies wey respond and continue di conversation, and replies wey deny wetin di person talk or answer rudely.

2253.translation: Di answer na Let's stop working for now. Call it a day na idiom wey mean 'make we stop work for today'. If you choose answer about phone or date because of di separate words call and day, you go wrong.

2254.translation: For idioms, no translate word by word; use di whole situation work out di meaning.

2255.translation: Think wetin naturally follow di sentence before, "I've worked for six hours."

2256.translation: Di answer na request make person close di window or increase di heating. E sound like weather comment, but na indirect request. Options about weather forecast or where thermometer dey only follow di literal meaning, so dem wrong.

2257.translation: For indirect expression, think wetin di speaker want make person do for that situation, no be di literal meaning alone.

2258.translation: Think which action visitor for cold room go want from di host, wey go solve di problem.

2259.translation: "Your ideas are strong; maybe the ending could be a bit clearer." tactful because e mention di strengths first, then use gentle expressions like maybe and a bit to suggest improvement. "Your ending is terrible..." honest but rude because e criticize di person directly.

2260.translation: Tactful mean say you talk without hurting di other person feelings. Find di sentence wey honest and gentle.

2261.translation: Compare whether each option acknowledge di friend strengths, and di tone wey e use talk about wetin need improvement.

2262.translation: Di answer na say di two people briefly contact each other and share how things dey go. Touch base na when you contact person briefly to share news or progress. If base make you think of game, you go wrong.

2263.translation: Workplace idioms fit confuse person if dem translate am literally. First think di kind work situation where dem dey use di phrase.

2264.translation: Check say di coworker talk "next week", and di action wey di suggestion ask di two people to take for di work conversation.

2265.translation: Di answer na postponed. E mean move schedule go later time, wey fit until next Monday. Finished mean say di meeting don end, wey no fit 'until next Monday'.

2266.translation: Check di result wey di reason and time for di blank sentence dey show.

2267.translation: Check whether di schedule change fit both di reason, say di manager sick, and di limit of next Monday.

2268.translation: Di answer na out. Run out of mean 'nothing remain'. Away and off fit follow run, but dem no form this meaning with of.

2269.translation: Join 'running' before di blank, 'of' after am and 'printer paper' after 'of' to reason di situation. Try di four options one after another and read aloud to check whether 'running ___ of ...' sound natural as one expression.

2270.translation: Di next sentence give reason say dem need order more paper. Use am reason wetin don happen to di paper supply.

2271.translation: Di answer na at. Be good at + -ing dey show ability. Good of dey praise person action, like 'how kind of you', so no be expression for ability.

2272.translation: Use collocation check which preposition follow di adjective good.

2273.translation: Di gerund solving follow am, so find di preposition for talking about ability to do something well.

2274.translation: Di answer na for your information. E mean 'make I let you know for reference', and dem dey use am for email. For your invitation match F and Y, but I become invitation, wey change di meaning.

2275.translation: Expand di abbreviation using di first letters of words, and check whether e fit di purpose for di message beginning.

2276.translation: E dey come before message to let di other person know something. Compare di words for F, Y and I for di options.

2277.translation: person after di blank na noun, so di adjective reliable (wey person fit trust) wey describe am correct. Reliably na adverb, so e no fit modify noun.

2278.translation: Di four words get di same root, so part of speech matter pass meaning. First decide di role wey di blank play inside di sentence.

2279.translation: Check di part of speech of di word immediately after di blank, and reason which part of speech dey describe that word.

2280.translation: Di answer na describe image for people wey no fit see am. Alt text dey tell screen readers, or users when image no load, wetin di image contain. Na other technology dey prevent copying.

2281.translation: Break down di name of di term. Alt short for alternative.

2282.translation: Think who di feature dey help and for which situation, then first remove di options wey far from that purpose.

2283.translation: Di answer na The new park is the most beautiful place in town. "Most beautiful" na judgment wey fit different from person to person, so na opinion. Di opening month, area and number of playgrounds na facts wey person fit check.

2284.translation: Facts fit get verification, but opinions fit different from person to person. Judge whether person fit verify each sentence.

2285.translation: Check whether na information wey person fit verify, like date, area or count, and whether e contain judgment words.

2286.translation: Di answer na assuming say di tea cause di improvement. If person feel better after drinking tea, that one alone no show say na di tea cause am. Formal style na writing style, no be weakness for reasoning.

2287.translation: Summarize for one line di reason wey di advert start from and di conclusion wey e reach. Then ask yourself whether that reason alone enough to support di conclusion. Check too whether di option discuss di reasoning connection or only how di writing look.

2288.translation: Focus on how di conclusion connect drinking tea to getting better, and remove options about vocabulary or writing style.

2289.translation: Di answer na Students gather with balloons at the annual school fair. Di students, balloons and school event all match di photo. Option like runner wey cross finish line alone no resemble di photo at all.

2290.translation: Caption suppose describe di people, place and actions wey really dey visible for di photo.

2291.translation: First list di people, place and props for di scene wey di question describe, then compare how each option match dem.

2292.translation: Di answer na Track changes. E dey mark changes and show suggested edits without deleting di original text. Print preview only show how page go look when dem print am, so e no relate to suggested edits.

2293.translation: Set out di conditions wey you want: suggest edits but no erase di original text.

2294.translation: Check whether each option relate to document editing, and if e relate, whether e show changes while preserving di original.

2295.translation: Echo chamber na group where you keep hearing only opinions wey resemble your own, so your belief dey get stronger. Chat room wey repeat message twice only repeat sound or text; e no be di same as bias for opinion.

2296.translation: Echo chamber na figurative expression, no be actual room. Think wetin di echo of sound represent online.

2297.translation: Think wetin dey return again like echo, and separate sound options from options about how people think.

2298.translation: Di answer na language wey people with different mother tongues dey use together. Di work wey English dey do for international communication na example. Language wey only one family dey use no serve this role for di example.

2299.translation: No fear if di Latin expression strange to you. First compare how each option describe who dey use di language, then remove options wey add condition wey too narrow or awkward if you take am literally.

2300.translation: Compare who dey use di language for each option and how those people relate.

2301.translation: Di answer na stereotype. Na belief wey oversimplify whole group. Dialect na di way people for one region dey talk, no be belief about people.

2302.translation: For definition question, pick di key words. Oversimplified and whole group na di keys.

2303.translation: First separate whether each option word na belief about group, way of speaking, event or family.

2304.translation: Di answer na diversity. Cultural diversity mean different cultures dey together. Division mean splitting apart, wey contrast with 'living together'.

2305.translation: For words wey spelling resemble, use di explanation after di blank compare di meanings.

2306.translation: Compare di description say people from different backgrounds dey live together with di meaning of di noun wey naturally follow cultural.

2307.translation: Di answer na Their customs are different from ours, and I would like to learn why. E show say di speaker accept differences and want learn. Words like strange and backward dey insult di other culture.

2308.translation: For cultural-sensitivity questions, check whether di speaker judge other cultures or try understand dem.

2309.translation: Check whether words like all, wrong or backward generalize cultures or rank some above others.

2310.translation: Di answer na authentic. E mean genuine, wey person fit trust. Artificial mean 'man-made'; for this question, e contrast with genuine.

2311.translation: Explain genuine, di key word for di definition, with simpler words.

2312.translation: Think wetin mean di opposite of "not copied", then remove di option with that opposite meaning first.

2313.translation: Indigenous mean originally from one region, native to di land. Foreign mean from another country, wey contrast with am.

2314.translation: Read di definition and understand di main meaning, then compare am with each word meaning one after another.

2315.translation: Focus on di phrase "the first people who lived in a region." From di words about fashion, era or origin, find di one wey fit.

2316.translation: Di answer na foreshadowing. Na story technique wey hint at wetin go happen later. Flashback dey return to past scene, so no be hint about future event.

2317.translation: For literary term, remember di definition and apply am to how di events unfold. For which point inside di story di technique dey work?

2318.translation: Check di order between when dem mention say di bridge dey weak and when di bridge collapse.

2319.translation: Di answer na peace. For literature, white dove na traditional symbol of peace. Danger no fit scene where war don end.

2320.translation: For poem, animal or object fit be symbol. Connect am to di mood of di scene where e appear.

2321.translation: Think di condition wey people want after war don end, then find di word for that condition.

2322.translation: Di answer na omniscient point of view. Na because di narrator know wetin several characters dey think. Limited point of view dey give only one character thoughts, so e no fit example wey show di inner thoughts of two people.

2323.translation: For point-of-view questions, check who dey tell di story and how many people inner thoughts di narrator know.

2324.translation: Check whether di example narrate both Anna and Tom inner thoughts, then choose di point of view wey match that range.

2325.translation: Di answer na Kindness often comes back to those who give it. E express di story cause and effect as general idea about life. The story takes place in a market only describe di setting, no be theme.

2326.translation: Theme no be plot or setting; na di general idea about life wey di story dey express.

2327.translation: Check whether di option summarize di connection between di boy actions and di result for one sentence, and whether e no contradict di story.

2328.translation: Di answer na protagonist. Na di character for di centre of di story wey get goal and drive di events. Antagonist na character wey oppose di protagonist, so di role different.

2329.translation: Character terms different according to role. Di central character, di opponent and di storyteller no be di same roles.

2330.translation: Compare di question description, "wants something and drives the action," with each option term definition.

2331.translation: Pattern where stressed and unstressed syllables repeat regularly na rhythm (meter). Plot structure na di order of di events, no be sound pattern.

2332.translation: Explain di question definition (stressed and unstressed syllables, regular pattern) for your own words for one sentence, then choose di option wey fit am.

2333.translation: When stressed and unstressed syllables alternate, how e feel when you read am aloud? Find di term wey name that feeling.

2334.translation: Di answer na Bandwagon appeal. Na di reasoning error wey claim say something correct only because many people dey do am. Hasty generalization na to generalize too quickly from few cases, so e different from di main point here.

2335.translation: For reasoning-error question, first ask whether di claim depend on evidence or something else.

2336.translation: Compare how "everyone does it" dey justify di claim with each reasoning error name.

2337.translation: Di answer na The park, which opened in May, covers four hectares. E contain only facts wey person fit check: opening time and area. The best thing the council has ever done na judgment, so na subjective opinion.

2338.translation: Objective sentence contain only information wey anybody fit verify, without personal judgment or feeling.

2339.translation: For each sentence, find words wey express judgment or feeling, like wonderful, fool and best.

2340.translation: Di answer na motion. Na di statement wey be topic for debate. Rebuttal na answer wey challenge di other side argument, no be di topic itself.

2341.translation: Arrange debate terms according to di role wey each one play for debate.

2342.translation: Compare wetin "the statement the two teams argue about" mean with di terms for rebuttal, ruling and record.

2343.translation: Di answer na Statistical evidence. Na numbers wey come from survey of many people. Anecdotal evidence na personal experience of one or two people, so e different from this survey.

2344.translation: Kinds of evidence different according to di source: expert statement, personal experience, assumptions, numbers and so on.

2345.translation: Check wetin di sample size (2,000 people) and percentage (64%) show about di kind of evidence.

2346.translation: Di answer na persuasive. After be verb, di complement wey describe di subject need adjective. Persuasively na adverb, so e no fit describe di speech for that position.

2347.translation: First decide di part of speech for di blank. Which part of speech di surrounding word order need?

2348.translation: For di structure "was highly ___," check say na position wey describe di subject speech, then choose di part of speech wey fit.

2349.translation: E reject di proposal because of Lena past behaviour, no be di proposal content, so na ad hominem. Straw man dey attack distorted version of di opponent argument, but dem no distort di proposal here.
